{{Top|leg}}
A shrub bush was a bush found on [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It had large, red, fruit-like objects growing from its stems, which the [[Bordok/Legends|Bordok]] known as [[Baga]] liked to eat. When Baga's owner, [[Malani]], attempted to paint him, he kept eating the fruits of the shrub bush instead of remaining still, and Malani asked him to remains so she could paint him. The Ewok Wicket then mistook the painting for a picture of the shrub bush instead of a picture of Baga, which caused Malani to cry.<ref name="Episode 5">{{Ewoks|Just My Luck}}</ref>
